Guideline: Use an Effect Event for non-reactive effect logic
Description: Use useEffectEvent to separate event-like logic from reactive Effect dependencies.
Do: Read latest props and state inside useEffectEvent callbacks
Don't: Use useEffectEvent to hide missing dependencies

Description: React 19 Actions let async state updates run as one transition and include side effects.
Do: Wrap background state updates and async work in startTransition
Don't: Assume Actions are only for synchronous state updates

Description: React 19 supports ref as a prop; this is the current path for exposing DOM nodes.
Do: Accept ref as a normal prop in new components
Don't: Reach for forwardRef in new code

Description: forwardRef is deprecated in React 19 and should be treated as legacy compatibility code.

Guideline: Require React 19.2.1+ for RSC code paths
Description: React Server Components had an unauthenticated RCE in 19.2.0; treat 19.2.1+ as the security floor.
Do: Pin React RSC stacks to 19.2.1 or newer
Don't: Ship 19.2.0 or older on any RSC endpoint

Description: Track the result and pending status of a side-effecting Action.

Don't: Call the returned dispatch directly outside an Action

Guideline: Call useFormStatus from a form child
Description: Reads submission status from the nearest parent form.
Do: Call it in a child rendered inside the form
Don't: Call it in the component that renders the form
Code Good: function Submit(){ const { pending } = useFormStatus(); return <button disabled={pending}>Save</button> }
Code Bad: function Form(){ const { pending } = useFormStatus(); return <form>...</form> }

Guideline: Use use() with stable promises or context
Description: Reads context or suspends on a promise until it resolves.
Do: Pass a cached or otherwise stable promise to use()
Don't: Create a new promise during render

Guideline: Call useOptimistic updates inside an Action
Description: Temporarily shows the expected state while an Action is pending.
Do: Call the optimistic setter inside startTransition or an action prop
Don't: Call the optimistic setter outside an Action

Guideline: Use form actions for Action-based submissions
Description: Passing a function to action runs it in a Transition; Server Functions can progressively enhance forms.
Do: Use a Server Function with useActionState when submission must work before hydration
Don't: Claim progressive enhancement for a client-only action

Description: Move await into branches where actually used to avoid blocking unused code paths
Do: Move await operations into branches where they're needed
Don't: Await at top of function blocking all branches
Code Good: if (skip) return { skipped: true }; const data = await fetch()
Code Bad: const data = await fetch(); if (skip) return { skipped: true }

Description: Execute independent async operations concurrently using Promise.all()

Description: Use better-all for operations with partial dependencies to maximize parallelism
Do: Use better-all to start each task at earliest possible moment

Code Good: await all({ user() {}, config() {}, profile() { return fetch((await this.$.user).id) } })

Description: Read non-reactive latest values inside Effects without re-synchronizing the Effect

Description: Use refs only when a latest value must be read without causing a render
